role: Independent non-authoring evidence judge (ICARUS Claude Opus 4.8), S3 preflight lane
non_blocking_risks: SSH host-key security uses first-use pinning via two back-to-back ssh-keyscans, not provider-signed attestation; a MITM present at first contact would not be caught by scan comparison. Impact is bounded: no credentials traverse SSH and all requests/results are hash-chained, sequence/parent-bound, and strict-schema validated. Disclosed in wiring and attempt receipt.

RunPod does not expose cryptographic image-digest readback on this CPU Pod surface; image identity relies on creation request + registry digest lookup + post-start runtime evidence (uname/os-release/binary sha256) rather than provider-attested digest. Disclosed.

4-GiB shape sufficiency is extrapolated from a 6-hour S2 run (peak RSS 836,284,416 B) to a 12-hour production run; fail-closed RSS enforcement (1,610,612,736 B) plus RAM headroom and provider terminate deadline bound the risk, but 12h behavior at 4 GiB is not directly measured.

cloud_adapter decodes the SQL password to an immutable Python str for PGPASSWORD; the bytearray is zeroed and PGPASSWORD popped, but the transient str cannot be scrubbed. Host-side only, low residual exposure.

Operational window is tight: at the packet's recorded time (~2026-07-27T01:07Z) the campaign-ready deadline (01:50Z) and retry-window end (02:00Z) leave little margin for A02 create/upload/smoke/start; mechanical deadline checks fail closed if missed.

evidence_gaps: Packet is sanitized and the judge has no tools; stated SHA-256 values (bundles, source files, CockroachDB and runpodctl binaries) cannot be recomputed. Hash correctness rests on internal cross-reference consistency, not independent recomputation.

Full worker/host bundle file listings are not enumerated in-packet; credential-free and secret-scan results (gitleaks/detect-secrets/private-path = zero) are asserted in the local preflight receipt rather than shown as raw scanner output.
